headline: SG freebies: last weekend for a free LEGO polybag at the Brick Sorting Challenge (to Sun 29 Nov); Katong-Joo Chiat keychains end Sun 6 Dec + 14 more
verdict: This weekend, do the free LEGO Brick Sorting Challenge at any LEGO Certified Store: a guaranteed polybag, no purchase needed, last weekend.

plan.do: Joo Chiat: get stamps at 6 heritage food shops, then redeem the keychain pack at Joo Chiat CC. Go early: while stocks last.
Parkway Parade B1 Mochiak & AhWoo pop-up sticker. Then Tampines Mall LEGO Certified Store: 30-second brick sort for a free polybag.
Tiong Bahru Plaza L2 Concierge: PEANUTS postcard, 4 stamp stations, PEANUTS collectible. Then The Centrepoint L3: free PEANUTS postcard with postage.
Great Christmas Village, opposite Ngee Ann City: 4 LEGO Toy Factory stations for a LEGO voucher and a kids' mini-build.
